text.tspan: U.S. Energy Information Administration | AEO2026 Narrative 6
This dot-plot is a visual representation of the energy fuel mix, tracked by decade, across all 10 side cases
and the Counterfactual Baseline. It illustrates how varying assumptions embedded in each case can
demonstrably alter future pathways, on the one hand, but also how certain ranges of outcomes appear
robust under multiple scenarios. In the cases that we have modeled here, the greatest variation arises in
the proportion of overall energy demand that is attributed to natural gas and petroleum.
